section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch1 — Indian History
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: Ashoka's edicts, carved on rocks and pillars across his empire, were mostly written in which script?

options.option_text: Brahmi (in most regions), with Kharosthi in the north-west

explanation: Most Ashokan edicts used Brahmi script (ancestor of many modern Indian scripts); some north-western edicts used Kharosthi, and a few used Greek/Aramaic in border regions.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch1 — Indian History
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: Alauddin Khalji is particularly remembered in economic history for introducing:

options.option_text: Market control and price regulation reforms
The first paper currency in India

explanation: Alauddin Khalji implemented strict market control and price-fixing (Market Reforms) to maintain a large standing army affordably — a notable medieval economic administration measure.

explanation: Robert Clive's forces defeated Siraj-ud-Daulah at Plassey (1757), largely through the betrayal of Mir Jafar — a turning point establishing British control over Bengal's revenue and administration.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch1 — Indian History
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The immediate trigger for the 1857 Revolt among Indian sepoys was widely attributed to:

options.option_text: Rumours that new cartridges were greased with cow and pig fat, offending religious sentiments
A sudden increase in soldiers' salaries
The British granting full independence prematurely

explanation: The Enfield rifle cartridges, rumoured to be greased with cow (sacred to Hindus) and pig (forbidden to Muslims) fat, deeply offended sepoys of both religions, serving as the immediate spark alongside deeper long-term grievances.
